name: layo
description: Make short brand videos starring AI influencers you design, with Layo.

interface.longDescription:
Layo makes short videos for brands, starring AI influencers you design.

An influencer is an invented person with a consistent look and voice that you reuse across videos. In Codex you can create an influencer from a description, choose their look and voice, and make a short video of them from a prompt, with an optional spoken line. You can also list the influencers and videos already in your Layo workspace.

Layo asks before it makes anything, and it makes invented people only: it won't copy a real person's likeness.
defaultPrompt: Make a 5-second video of my influencer at the beach.
Create a new influencer: a cheerful barista in her twenties.
